changelog: Performance: new low-latency runtime targets sub-second cached search/playback and keeps foreground network operations bounded below three seconds.
Fix: search continuation parsing accepts multiple live YouTube Music response shapes and expands up to 150 tracks instead of remaining at the first batch.
Fix: search pages return their own 50-track slice from the shared result set instead of repeating page 1.
Performance: playback resolutions are deduplicated and cached, with automatic next-track prefetch from the active search result set.
Performance: Home returns cached shelves immediately and refreshes in the background.
Compatibility: original gateway exports and legacy index.js remain intact; fast.js is now the production runtime entry point.
Previous production release retained for rollback.
